title: AES-GCM-SIV AAD Forgery After Zero-length Incremental AAD Update
description: CVE-2026-88823 is a vulnerability in Microsoft product version 3.0 involving AES-GCM-SIV authenticated encryption. It relates to an AAD (Additional Authenticated Data) forgery issue triggered after a zero-length incremental AAD update. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
